title: Explainable Legal Case Matching via Inverse Optimal Transport-based Rationale Extraction
reasoning: The paper focuses on explainable legal case matching, aiming to provide faithful and plausible explanations for legal decisions. While legal decisions naturally involve concepts of justice and fairness, the paper's core contribution and evaluation are technical (matching accuracy, rationale extraction, explanation generation quality), rather than directly evaluating or benchmarking the AI's moral, ethical, or religious reasoning capabilities.
